misconception.why: All the examples were a personal website and bios. Nothing was about operations, trucks or depots, so AI still looks like a chatbot or a writing tool to me. Only the 'AI guesses to fill gaps' part rang a bell, because reports with wrong numbers worry me.

one_line: Too much talk and a personal website for a logistics guy. I learned not to trust AI checking itself, but I would have liked to see a depot report.
